# DateTime

## Summary
Base-realm field. Lives at `https://cardstack.com/base/datetime` (default export). Primitive instant, serialized ISO 8601 with timezone; renders localized date + time. Used by review threads and activity logs.

## Usage
```ts
import DateTimeField from 'https://cardstack.com/base/datetime';
```

Example: value `"2026-08-14T09:30:00.000Z"`
